D: Riley heads to hockey camp as a teenager and a crowd of new emotions moves into headquarters.
P: Serve the snacks when Riley arrives at hockey camp.
S: Soft pretzel bites boiled briefly in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with a warm cheddar sauce.
Anxiety planning for every possible thing that could go wrong
A bit of everything on one big board: cheddar, crackers, grapes, roasted almonds, baby carrots and hummus, so nobody is caught short.
Joy trying to keep things bright
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter, a pinch of turmeric and salt so it glows yellow.
M: lunch in the hockey camp cafeteria
Penne mixed with chicken, broccoli and a creamy parmesan and garlic sauce, topped with cheese and baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
dinner at home with Riley's mum and dad
Beef mince cooked with cumin, paprika and tomato, served in taco shells with lettuce, tomato, cheddar and sour cream.
W: Fudgy chocolate brownies with a crackly top, cut into big squares. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter.
K: Chamomile tea brewed with honey, cooled, mixed with apple juice and poured over ice.

s.note: Anxiety planning for every possible thing that could go wrong
s.how: Arrange cubes of cheddar, water crackers, bunches of red grapes, roasted almonds, baby carrots and a bowl of hummus on one big board. Fill every gap. Then add a few more crackers just in case, because you can never be too prepared.

s.note: Joy trying to keep things bright
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn. Melt 60g butter with a small pinch of ground turmeric and pour over the popcorn while tossing so it glows sunny yellow. Season with salt and pour into a big bright bowl.

m.note: dinner at home with Riley's mum and dad
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince with a spoon each of cumin and paprika, then stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and a splash of water and simmer 10 minutes. Warm taco shells and set out shredded lettuce, diced tomato, grated cheddar and sour cream so everyone builds their own.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter. Whisk in 300g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170C for 28 minutes and cool before cutting.

d.how: Brew 4 chamomile tea bags in 500ml boiling water for 5 minutes and stir in 2 tbsp honey. Cool completely, then mix with 500ml apple juice. Pour over ice in tall glasses and take a slow deep breath before the first sip.
